llm_response.reason: The website displays several scam indicators: it offers a broad and unrelated product range; uses only cryptocurrency payments (USDT/ETH/BTC), which is highly unusual for legitimate e-commerce; contains misleading company details and attempts to associate with Shopify in a suspicious way; lacks legitimate business contact information and uses ambiguous online customer service; artificially inflates its sales numbers to create fake social proof; and employs urgency/discounter language commonly associated with scams. These characteristics match those of fake online shopping scams.
